basic_info.description: Enjoy breathtaking ocean views from Ocean Beach down the coast. This 1923 5BD/3BA home is on the south side of Geary in the Outer Richmond. The top floor offers panoramic views of the Pacific & Golden Gate Park. The modern kitchen with Corian counters opens up to a great view from the breakfast room, and the breakfast bar opens to the spacious living room with gas fireplace. You'll love the expansiveness & views of these rooms. There's an original built-in with drawers & cabinets that leads to the kitchen & formal dining room. At the front of the home is a full bath and 2 bedrooms which overlook the street. The main level has 2 bedrooms, seperated by a bathroom and the primary suite overlooks the view & leads to the office or sitting room and large bathroom, with spa tub. Additional highlights include a two-car garage (all interested should test their car/s on driveeay and into garage) , brick patio & yard, studio room, and plans for a Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit (JADU). This elegant & spacious home is located near Lands End, Ocean Beach, Balboa St. shops & restaurants,Lincoln & Golden Gate Parks.
